d: We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Sales Representative with at least 1 year of experience in the Electrical Industry. The candidate will be responsible for generating new business opportunities, developing customer relationships, and managing existing clients through field sales activities.
Generate new business leads and identify potential customers in the assigned territory.
Manage and maintain relationships with existing customers.
Promote and sell electrical products to B2B and/or B2C customers.
Conduct regular field visits to meet prospective and existing clients.
Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable electrical products.
Follow up on sales enquiries, quotations, and business opportunities.
Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to business growth.
Maintain regular reports of sales activities, customer visits, and lead generation.
Minimum 1 year of experience as a Sales Representative in the Electrical Industry.
Experience in either B2B or B2C sales is acceptable.
Candidates must be currently residing in Oman, irrespective of nationality.
Must be comfortable with field sales and customer visits.
Good communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to generate new leads and manage existing customer accounts.
Immediate joiners or candidates available to join within 15–20 days are preferred.
Visa: Company-sponsored visa for non-Omani candidates.
Transportation: Company-provided bike for field sales activities.
Important Note: Only candidates currently based in Oman with relevant Electrical Industry sales experience will be considered.
